brief.headline: They need our ₹28.31 Cr (9.72% of their sales) and their cash is stuck for 81 days — trade faster payment for a ₹32.69 L/yr price cut to match our best price

priceAsk.summary: Cut price by ₹32.69 L/yr to match the ₹290.00/KG we already pay Shrinath Roto Pack for the same laminates
priceAsk.basis: We pay Shrinath Roto Pack ₹290.00/KG for identical Electral laminate SKUs; GEEP charges ₹294.03/KG (1.4% gap) to ₹308.30/KG (6.3% gap). Market asking price is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so ₹290 sits at the top of the fair band and is already proven in our supply chain.

paymentTermAsk.summary: If they meet the ₹290/KG target, we'll pay in 15 days instead of 30
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹1.16 Cr of our cash, but it's worth ~4.38% to them (their borrowing rate), so they save roughly ₹5 L/yr in interest — a fair swap for the price cut

brief.financialLeverage: They keep only 1.1% of every ₹100 they sell as profit, so squeezing price too hard could break them. But their cash is stuck for 81 days, much longer than similar firms (46 days), which means cash is tight and faster payment is valuable to them. We're 9.72% of their ₹291.36 Cr revenue, so losing us would hurt. Push the price cut firmly (it brings us to a price we already pay elsewhere), but sweeten it with quicker payment — that plays to their cash crunch without threatening supply.

evidence.point: We're nearly a tenth of their business
Their cash is stuck much longer than peers
We pay Shrinath ₹290/KG; GEEP charges up to ₹308.30/KG
evidence.figure: Gap: 6.3% on LM ELECTRAL MD 21.80g LS 08

evidence.point: Market asking price confirms our target is fair
evidence.figure: ₹205–305/kg typical ₹250/kg — verdict: MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band)

evidence.point: Rating agency couldn't get their data

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already in our supply base — proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets; health C (58/100), ₹2755.75 Cr revenue

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant doing both film substrate and conversion — can handle our ₹28.31 Cr at scale; health C (46/100), ₹16492.00 Cr revenue

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India arm doing pharma sachet laminates — strong fit as a second source; health D (31/100), ₹222.04 Cr revenue

risks: They're 76% of our Laminates spend (₹28.31 Cr) — no approved backup today, so pushing too hard could leave us stranded; qualify Huhtamaki or UFLEX fast
CRISIL BB+ / Stable but the rating agency says they stopped sharing info, so their real financial health is uncertain — watch for supply hiccups
GST filing delays, EPF payment delays, and pending legal cases all on record — suggests operational stress that could spill into delivery
Their profit is only 1.1% — a big price cut without the payment-term offset could push them into the red and threaten continuity
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: You're a key partner — 9.72% of your revenue comes from us — so let's find a win-win: we'll match the ₹290/KG we pay Shrinath and move to 15-day payment to help your cash flow.
